Is the 12+2 ok for me? I climbed Mont Bl.short_program_en: To be honest, the 12+2 is only for people who have already been above 6,000 m, are very well trained and arrive acclimatized. Mont Blanc (4,806 m) doesn't reach that altitude. I'd recommend the 18+2: same price, more days to acclimatize, and that's what raises your summit chances the most.
Is the 12+2 ok for me? I climbed Mont Bl.short_program_es: Te soy sincero: el 12+2 es solo para quien ya estuvo arriba de los 6.000 m, está muy entrenado y llega aclimatado. El Mont Blanc (4.806 m) no llega a esa altura. Te recomiendo el 18+2: cuesta lo mismo y tiene más días para aclimatar, que es lo que más sube las chances de cumbre.
Is the 12+2 ok for me? I climbed Mont Bl.short_program_pt: Sendo sincero: o 12+2 é só para quem já esteve acima de 6.000 m, está muito bem treinado e chega aclimatado. El Mont Blanc (4.806 m) não chega a essa altitude. Recomendo o 18+2: custa o mesmo e tem mais dias para aclimatar, o que mais aumenta as chances de cume.
